title: P8 Browser Deploy Binding
objective: Bind the exact browser distribution deployed to Cloudflare to the authenticated P8 numerical release gate and reject substituted distribution bytes

oracles: Release-gate unit tests with exact positive distribution and substituted-byte negative cases

handoff.summary: The release-gate authenticator can now bind a repository-local browser distribution to artifact_coherence.browser_distribution_content_sha256. Cloudflare deployment authenticates the downloaded reproducible packages/flint-wasm/dist before receipt validation or staging, with positive workflow coverage and a byte-substitution rejection test.
risks: The broader pnpm test:changed run reached architecture:check after a successful build, then failed because this narrowly scoped CJS/test change invalidates the repository-wide generated optimizer-opportunity input digest. Refreshing those global artifacts is intentionally left to integration so this lane stays within its deployment/gate-binding claim; the focused binding tests and merge invariants pass.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this lane commit into the PR 95 integration branch.
When soak evidence is added to the release gate, extend the same optional authentication pattern without weakening this browser-distribution binding.
